headline: Diesel keeps rallying as Saudi refinery attacks rattle supply outlook
intro: Diesel can't catch a break — cracks are blowing out even as the SPR taps open, and now Houthi missiles are landing near Saudi refining assets. Gasoline, meanwhile, is just sort of along for the ride.
overview: Diesel remains the market's pressure point: ULSD spot is near $5/gal with a diesel crack above $113/bbl, and US distillate stocks are at historical lows heading into heating season even as export-ban threats fade. Crude and product prices rose through Q3 on Middle East conflict, and that conflict escalated further Monday with reported Houthi strikes on Saudi Aramco refining sites near Riyadh and the Petro Rabigh complex, alongside a coordinated G7/SPR emergency release meant to calm markets. On the policy side, biofuels and SAF activity continues apace — record soybean oil use in US biofuel production, new EU/French SAF support mechanisms, and fresh manure-to-gas tax credit guidance from the IRS.

stories.title: Energy Markets Mixed As Diesel Rallies And Supply Concerns Persist
stories.summary: Diesel prices rallied again to start the week despite Friday's SPR reserve-release announcement, while WTI and RBOB futures slipped modestly.

stories.title: US diesel stocks low as export control threat wanes
stories.summary: US distillate stocks have slumped to historical lows just as peak heating demand arrives, even as the threat of a diesel export ban recedes.

stories.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
stories.summary: EIA reports crude oil prices and refinery margins generally rose through Q3 2026 amid persistent Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Oil's bearish signals are piling up but here's why Brent is still above $100
stories.summary: Oil slipped Monday as coordinated emergency stock releases and a Middle East export recovery eased shortage fears, though Brent held above $100.

stories.title: Big Attack On Saudi Arabia's Oil Refinery: Houthis Target Aramco In Riyadh, Claim 'Operations Achieved Objectives'
stories.summary: Houthis claimed a ballistic missile and drone attack on Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh and the Khurais area.

stories.title: Houthis launch new attack on Riyadh oil refinery as Saudis hit back with counter-strikes on Yemen as conflict hiking world oil prices intensifies
stories.summary: A fresh Houthi attack reportedly sent smoke and flames around a Riyadh-area oil refinery as Saudi forces launched counter-strikes on Yemen.

stories.title: Possible Fire Reported at Saudi Refinery as Attack Claims Circulate
stories.summary: Reports emerged of a possible attack on Saudi Arabia's Petro Rabigh refining and petrochemical complex near Jeddah, unconfirmed by authorities.

stories.title: USA Continues Strategic Petroleum Reserve Release
stories.summary: The US continues releasing Strategic Petroleum Reserve supplies, with Energy Secretary Chris Wright citing efforts to stabilize oil markets.

stories.title: Oil Falls as G7 Taps Emergency Supplies
stories.summary: Diesel and oil prices fell after G7 nations moved to release emergency supplies.

stories.title: Iran Oil Minister Quits as Exports Dry Up
stories.summary: Iran's Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned as the country's oil exports shrink under a tightening US blockade.

stories.title: Soybean oil used to produce US biofuels reaches new all-time high in July
stories.summary: US biofuel producers used record volumes of soybean oil in July, pushing total vegetable oil consumption by the sector to a new all-time high.

stories.title: Fossil fuel price surge and high demand lift biofuel production margins on both sides of the Atlantic in September
stories.summary: Rising fossil fuel prices and strong demand lifted biofuel production margins on both sides of the Atlantic in September.

stories.title: France includes double-sided auction to subsidise up to 160,000 tonnes of e-SAF a year in 2027 draft budget
stories.summary: France's 2027 draft budget includes a double-sided auction subsidizing up to 160,000 tonnes of e-SAF annually via 15-year purchase contracts.

stories.title: New IRS rule rewards farms for turning manure to gas
stories.summary: New IRS guidance confirms gas from livestock manure qualifies for the clean fuel production tax credit.
